id: \bSamson: So good to be in Kanto again.
en: \bSamson: So good to be in Kanto again.
it: \bSamson: Che bello essere di nuovo a Kanto.

id: \bBrock: Welcome back \PN. It's been a long time. I'm still working at being a doctor, but don't think that's made me any easier. I'm still gym leader worthy.
en: \bBrock: Welcome back \PN. It's been a long time. I'm still working at being a doctor, but don't think that's made me any easier. I'm still gym leader worthy.
it: \bBrock: Bentornato, \PN. È passato tanto tempo. Sto ancora studiando per diventare medico, ma non pensare che questo mi abbia reso più facile da battere. Sono ancora all'altezza di un Capopalestra.

id: \bBrock: Wonderful battle. I imagine Misty will be even harder.
en: \bBrock: Wonderful battle. I imagine Misty will be even harder.
it: \bBrock: Una lotta splendida. Immagino che Misty sarà ancora più tosta.

id: \bGary: Impressive work. You might be good enough for Project Mew. Might.
en: \bGary: Impressive work. You might be good enough for Project Mew. Might.
it: \bGary: Ottimo lavoro. Potresti essere all'altezza del Progetto Mew. Forse.

id: \bGoh: I... think I'll join. I won't be left behind.
en: \bGoh: I... think I'll join. I won't be left behind.
it: \bGoh: Io... credo che mi unirò. Non resterò indietro.

id: \bGary: Ha. We'll see. A qualifying mission will be sent to you soon. See you don't fail it. I'll be rooting for you.
en: \bGary: Ha. We'll see. A qualifying mission will be sent to you soon. See you don't fail it. I'll be rooting for you.
it: \bGary: Ah. Vedremo. Presto ti verrà inviata una missione di qualificazione. Vedi di non fallirla. Farò il tifo per te.

id: \bGoh: I won't! I'll prove myself and find Mew.
en: \bGoh: I won't! I'll prove myself and find Mew.
it: \bGoh: Non fallirò! Dimostrerò quanto valgo e troverò Mew.

id: \bThanks for helping, \PN. Let's head back to the lab.
en: \bThanks for helping, \PN. Let's head back to the lab.

id: \rMisty: It's about time I get to see you again. It's been far too long since I've beat you.
en: \rMisty: It's about time I get to see you again. It's been far too long since I've beat you.
it: \rMisty: Era ora che ti rivedessi. È passato fin troppo tempo dall'ultima volta che ti ho battuto.

id: \rMisty: It's good to see you every now and then. Stop by more often.
en: \rMisty: It's good to see you every now and then.  Stop by more often.
it: \rMisty: È bello vederti ogni tanto.  Passa più spesso.

id: \bGoh: A Moltres. I'd like to see that. Let's try and find it.
en: \bGoh: A Moltres. I'd like to see that. Let's try and find it.
it: \bGoh: Un Moltres. Mi piacerebbe vederlo. Proviamo a trovarlo.

id: \bKukui: Are you surprised? Professor Oak asked these two here for the demonstration.
en: \bKukui: Are you surprised? Professor Oak asked these two here for the demonstration.
it: \bKukui: Sorpreso? Il Professor Oak ha invitato questi due qui per la dimostrazione.

id: \bKukui: That's it for our lesson. I hope everyone had fun here. Let's all head back to school.
en: \bKukui: That's it for our lesson. I hope everyone had fun here. Let's all head back to school.
it: \bKukui: La lezione finisce qui. Spero che vi siate divertiti tutti. Torniamo tutti a scuola.

id: \bGoh: This Moltres is tough. Help me out, \PN.
en: \bGoh: This Moltres is tough. Help me out, \PN.
it: \bGoh: Questo Moltres è tosto. Dammi una mano, \PN.

id: \rLillie: What an amazing place! So many Pokémon to discover.
en: \rLillie: What an amazing place! So many Pokémon to discover.
it: \rLylia: Che posto incredibile! Ci sono così tanti Pokémon da scoprire.

id: \bGary: \PN, good to see you again. Let's catch up more after I deal with this Moltres.
en: \bGary: \PN, good to see you again. Let's catch up more after I deal with this Moltres.
it: \bGary: \PN, che piacere rivederti. Facciamo due chiacchiere dopo che mi sarò occupato di questo Moltres.

id: \bKiawe: So many Fire types! It's almost too much!
en: \bKiawe: So many Fire types! It's almost too much!
it: \bKiawe: Quanti tipi Fuoco! È quasi troppo!

id: \bPaul: I heard you made it into the Masters Eight.
en: \bPaul: I heard you made it into the Masters Eight.
it: \bPaul: Ho sentito che sei entrato negli Otto Master.

id: \bWhat am I doing here? I came to study under Professor Oak. Any Trainer wishing to understand Pokémon better would do the same thing.
en: \bWhat am I doing here? I came to study under Professor Oak. Any Trainer wishing to understand Pokémon better would do the same thing.
it: \bChe ci faccio qui? Sono venuto a studiare sotto la guida del Professor Oak. Qualsiasi Allenatore desideroso di capire meglio i Pokémon farebbe lo stesso.

id: \bDo you understand your Pokémon? Show me in a battle.
en: \bDo you understand your Pokémon? Show me in a battle.
it: \bTu capisci i tuoi Pokémon? Dimostramelo in una lotta.

id: \bPaul: I think you might be ready. Don't disappoint me, okay? Later.
en: \bPaul: I think you might be ready. Don't disappoint me, okay? Later.
it: \bPaul: Penso che tu possa essere pronto. Non deludermi, chiaro? Ci si vede.

id: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:
en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Goh:
it: Smart Rotom: chiamata in arrivo da Goh:

id: \bGoh: Hey \PN. Could you meet me at Cerise Park? Thanks.
en: \bGoh: Hey \PN. Could you meet me at Cerise Park? Thanks.
it: \bGoh: Ehi, \PN. Potresti raggiungermi al Parco Cerise? Grazie.

id: \bTracey: Hi \PN. Come back for another visit?
en: \bTracey: Hi \PN. Come back for another visit?
it: \bTracey: Ciao, \PN. Sei tornato per un'altra visita?

id: \bTracey: You want to battle, huh? I guess so.
en: \bTracey: You want to battle, huh? I guess so.
it: \bTracey: Vuoi lottare, eh? Va bene, d'accordo.

id: \bSophocles: I wish there were some Electric types around...
en: \bSophocles: I wish there were some Electric types around...
it: \bChrys: Vorrei che ci fossero dei tipi Elettro qui in giro...

id: \bOak: Welcome home \PN! I'm sure you're excited to see your friends again.
en: \bOak: Welcome home \PN! I'm sure you're excited to see your friends again.
it: \bOak: Bentornato a casa, \PN! Sono sicuro che non vedi l'ora di rivedere i tuoi amici.

id: \bOak: Welcome home \PN! Thank you for coming on such short notice. I figured it's been some time since you were home to visit your Pokémon.
en: \bOak: Welcome home \PN! Thank you for coming on such short notice. I figured it's been some time since you were home to visit your Pokémon.
it: \bOak: Bentornato a casa, \PN! Grazie per essere venuto con così poco preavviso. Ho pensato che fosse da un po' che non tornavi a trovare i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bGoh: Um, Professor. Why did you invite me as well?
en: \bGoh: Um, Professor. Why did you invite me as well?
it: \bGoh: Ehm, Professore. Perché ha invitato anche me?

id: \bOak: Have you heard of Project Mew? It's an organization aimed at finding Mew. They're currently recruiting members.
en: \bOak: Have you heard of Project Mew? It's an organization aimed at finding Mew. They're currently recruiting members.
it: \bOak: Hai mai sentito parlare del Progetto Mew? È un'organizzazione che mira a trovare Mew. Al momento stanno reclutando membri.

id: \bGoh: I'm not sure. Working with a team isn't really my style.
en: \bGoh: I'm not sure. Working with a team isn't really my style.
it: \bGoh: Non saprei. Lavorare in squadra non è proprio il mio stile.

id: \bOak: Is that so? Well, that's alright. \PN, I forgot to mention, but Gary is also here. He's in the middle of looking for a Moltres for Project Mew.
en: \bOak: Is that so? Well, that's alright. \PN, I forgot to mention, but Gary is also here. He's in the middle of looking for a Moltres for Project Mew.
it: \bOak: Davvero? Beh, va bene così. \PN, dimenticavo di dirti che c'è anche Gary. Sta cercando un Moltres per il Progetto Mew.
\bForse voi due potreste unirvi a lui.

id: \bOak: Perhaps you two could join Gary finding Moltres.
en: \bOak: Perhaps you two could join Gary finding Moltres.
it: \bOak: Forse voi due potreste aiutare Gary a cercare Moltres.
